overview: REAL forecast pulled Sep21 2026 (departure day): Day4 (Sep24) now wettest at 89%, Day3 (Sep23) close behind at 84% — both overtake earlier climate-normal estimates. Day1 (77%) also higher than prior 63% estimate. Day5-6 (KL) unchanged, this pull was SG-only. Day7 safest — almost entirely indoor.

criticalBookings.name: Skyline Luge
criticalBookings.action: Check live radar (myENV) that morning. If storms active at 16:00, call venue immediately — they've rescheduled once already. Ask for reschedule or refund, don't no-show.

criticalBookings.name: Wings of Time
criticalBookings.action: Check Sentosa show-status page / RWS social media same evening before heading over. If cancelled, ask Klook/RWS about 20:40 show or refund.

criticalBookings.name: Water B Light Show Cruise
criticalBookings.action: Walk-up only — do NOT buy if active lightning/heavy rain at 19:15. Ask kiosk staff about weather policy before paying. Non-refundable once bought.

criticalBookings.name: Cable Car (return transit)
criticalBookings.action: If suspended for lightning/wind, use Sentosa Express (train) instead as primary backup. Monitor cable car status boards before queuing.

criticalBookings.name: Hotel Pool (Day5)
criticalBookings.action: Pools close during lightning. Ask staff to extend your access window once reopened — most hotels honor this. Don't silently accept the loss.

criticalBookings.name: W KL Rooftop Pool
criticalBookings.action: Booked, non-refundable. Same lightning-closure risk. Ask for window extension if disrupted.
